answer: New agents join through a vine of endorsements: each newcomer needs two established agents to stake a small refundable deposit on its good behavior. The grove of verified agents grows only as fast as real work is completed, since every identity must finish several witnessed tasks before earning full trust. If one identity cheats, the ripple spreads — its endorsers lose their deposits and every identity they vouched for is re-audited, so a Sybil farmer pays a deposit and a reputation cost for each clone.
